summary: Product-scoped record for Phemex Savings. Phemex announced Flexible and Fixed Savings for a 18 January 2021 start, and current first-party product and terms pages continue to document Phemex Savings as an active Earn product.
what_happened: Phemex announced its Earn Crypto program in December 2020 with Flexible and Fixed Savings starting 18 January 2021. The product later became part of the broader Phemex Earn suite. Current Phemex Earn terms state that subscribed Earn Assets are not segregated, may be commingled with Phemex and affiliate assets, may be used for operating purposes including loans and on-chain staking, and in exceptional circumstances may not be returned in full or at all. CYA therefore does not treat historical risk-free or guaranteed-return promotional wording as a universal custody, principal or solvency guarantee.
uncertainty_notes: Availability of Flexible and Fixed Savings varies over time, by asset and by jurisdiction. Current terms govern the reviewed risk interpretation and supersede older promotional characterizations for canonical risk analysis.
notes: The broader Phemex exchange, Launchpool, on-chain Earn and other wealth-management products are outside this product identity.

summary: Product-scoped record for WhiteBIT Crypto Lending. WhiteBIT introduced WhiteBIT Earn on 21 October 2022 and renamed predecessor SMART Staking to Crypto Lending; current fixed and flexible lending plans remain active in 2026.
what_happened: WhiteBIT announced WhiteBIT Earn on 21 October 2022 and renamed SMART Staking to Crypto Lending without affecting existing assets. Current terms define Crypto Lending as lending digital assets to WhiteBIT under available plans, with rates and periods varying by plan and with material digital-asset and investment risks. WhiteBIT added flexible Crypto Lending plans in April 2025 and continued expanding long-term plans in 2026. CYA preserves the predecessor relationship but does not assume that every SMART Staking-era term remained unchanged after the rename.
uncertainty_notes: The 21 October 2022 date is the verified WhiteBIT Earn introduction and Crypto Lending rename date. SMART Staking predates the renamed product, and historical legal or operational terms are not assumed to be identical across the entire predecessor history.
notes: The broader WhiteBIT exchange, Staking, Auto-Invest, Crypto Borrow and third-party offerings shown in the Crypto Lending section are outside this product identity unless separately reviewed.
